scenario: During a tech conference, two attendees discuss subscription cancellation policies for niche cloud services, focusing on the implications for auto-renewal and post-cancellation data access.
expected_outcome: Attendees understand that cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing period, and they retain access until then, with no refund for the current period.
context: Customers can cancel subscriptions through Account Settings, then Subscriptions, then Cancel Subscription.
Cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing period.
Customers retain access until the billing period ends.
Payments for the current billing period are not refunded.
